data.one_liner: A floating bubble button inspired by the Tokopedia application.
data.what_it_does: Provides a FloatBubble widget that can wrap a page to display a floating button style inspired by the Tokopedia application.
use_when: You want to add a floating bubble button to your page
You like the Tokopedia-style floating button interface
avoid_when: You need complex state management or advanced gesture controls not provided by the widget
strengths: Easy to wrap around a page
Provides a specific floating button style
weaknesses: Changelog and initial release details are incomplete
data.minimal_example: wrap the page with the FloatBubble widget
